author: Spartemex
body:
I've noticed, that in a player's profile, it shows where the last where (which server) and if you mouse over that, it tells you how many people are on. I think it would be cool, if you could click on the server name on the website, and it will show you the map, and where people are on it. I've seen a plug-in for it... http://www.curse.com/bukkit-plugins/minecraft/dynmap.  I know you might say that this might give people a tactical advantage, but the website already knows whoch server you're on, so you could limit access on that variable.  I know this all sounds really ambitious, I just think it would be a cool thing to add, and the plugin is already out there.

Like this:
